svg.title: phacops-delorme-48279 - original atlas schematic
svg.desc: Original educational schematic; not a photograph or exact reconstruction. Original generalized Phacops-like trilobite schematic emphasizing large eyes and an inflated glabella, not the Natla River collection's specimen, eye-lens counts, an exact segment count or a diagnostic P. natlensis reconstruction. The Early Emsian age envelope does not date this individual exactly to 400 Ma or establish continuous existence.
